data.name: SCP-51678G
data.description:
SCP-51678G IS NOT A PARTICULARLY DIFFICULT SUBJECT TO KEEP CONTAINED; IT SEEMS HAPPY TO SIT AND WAIT FOR ITS "MEALS" IN-BETWEEN FEEDINGS. WITHIN A STANDARD SCP CONTAINMENT CELL AND WITH REGULAR "MEALS", WE CAN KEEP IT CONTAINED WITH LITTLE TROUBLE. HOWEVER, IF "MEALS" ARE LATE OR WITHHELD FOR TOO LONG, SCP-51678G WILL GET VISIBLY ANGRY AND ITS STRENGTH WILL START TO INCREASE. IF LEFT WITHOUT A "MEAL" FOR MORE THAN TWO MONTHS, ITS STRENGTH IS ENOUGH TO EASILY BREAK CONCRETE. IF NO SCHEDULED "MEAL" IS ON SCP-51678G'S CALENDAR, PLEASE CONTACT

OR

"MEALS" SHALL BE PROVIDED VIA A "LOTTERY" MECHANISM FOR D-CLASS PERSONNEL. AS A REWARD FOR GOOD BEHAVIOR, THE WINNER WILL BE ALLOWED TO MATE WITH SCP-51678G. NO MENTION IS TO BE MADE OF THE RESULTS OF SAID MATING, AND ALL RUMORS ARE TO BE QUASHED IMMEDIATELY. AS MATING IS HOW SCP-51678G SEEMS TO SATISFY ITSELF, THE FOUNDATION VIEWS THIS AS KILLING TWO BIRDS WITH ONE STONE.

DESCRIPTION:

SCP-51678G IS A TALL GREEN HUMANOID MEASURING ABOUT 2.6 METERS IN HEIGHT. ITS BODY IS SIMILAR TO AN ABNORMALLY BUXOM WOMAN. AUTOPSY HAS REVEALED THAT THE ORGANS INSIDE OF SCP-51678G'S BODY ARE NOT HUMAN, BUT INSTEAD A SERIES OF ENDOCRINE MANUFACTURERS AND REPRODUCTIVE ORGANS. WHILE SCP-51678G MAY APPEAR TO BE A TALL, SEXY GREEN WOMAN ON FIRST GLANCE, IN REALITY IT IS MUCH DIFFERENT.

SCP-51678G'S HEAD IS NOT HUMAN; INSTEAD IT HAS AN ELONGATED JAW, SIMILAR TO A DOG OR A HORSE. HAS REMARKED THAT ITS HEAD APPEARS FROM THE SIMILAR TO A SERIES OF VIDEO GAMES. SCP-51678G HAS NO APPARENT SENSORY ORGANS. INSTEAD, IT SEEMS TO "FEEL" ITS WAY AROUND ITS ENVIRONMENT THROUGH CHANGES IN WIND CURRENTS. IT HAS TINY FINE HAIRS ALL OVER ITS BODY, ALMOST NAKED TO THE HUMAN EYE, WHICH PICK UP THESE WIND CURRENTS AND ALLOW SCP-51678G A FALSE, 360-DEGREE VERSION OF "VISION".

"VISION" IS NOT SCP-51678G'S PRIMARY SENSORY ORGAN. IN FACT, SCP-51678G HAS A COMPLEX NEUROLOGICAL AND MUSCULAR SYSTEM CONCENTRATED BOTH ON ITS REPRODUCTIVE ORGANS AND THE LARGE PINK LIPS ON ITS MOUTH. IT USES THESE SYSTEMS TO ENTRAP AND CONTAIN ITS "MEALS" WHILE IT HEAVILY MASSAGES ITS MEAL'S REPRODUCTIVE ORGANS WHILE INJECTING TINY AMOUNTS OF APHRODISIAC INTO SAID ORGANS. TEST SUBJECTS HAVE SAID THAT THE FEELING IS AKIN TO BEING DRIVEN INSANE BY LUST, WITH ALL HIGHER FUNCTIONING CEASING AS THE "MEAL" MATES WITH SCP-51678G OVER AND OVER AND OVER.

SCP-51678G APPEARS TO HAVE AN OVERWHELMING URGE TO MATE WITH HUMAN MALES BETWEEN THE AGES OF 20 AND 40; IT SEEMS TO REJECT MALES OUTSIDE ITS DESIRED AGE RANGE, AND IT ALSO REJECTS WOMEN AND PEOPLE WITHOUT MALE REPRODUCTIVE ORGANS. THE REASON FOR THIS IS SIMPLE: SCP-51678G'S GREATEST DESIRE IS TO BE REPEATEDLY IMPREGNATED. AFTER A HUMAN MALE GIVES SCP-51678G HIS GENETIC DATA, ITS EGG RAPIDLY GROWS INTO A NEW SCP-51678G WITHIN ONE WEEK. NO BIRTH HAS EVER BEEN OBSERVED. INSTEAD, A NEW FULLY GROWN VERSION OF SCP-51678G POPS INTO EXISTENCE INSIDE OF SCP-51678G'S CELL ONCE THE WEEK HAS FULLY PASSED.

SCP-51678G HAS EXHIBITED THE ABILITY TO SPEAK, BUT NOT COMMUNICATE. SCP-51678G'S VOCAL PATTERNS ARE SIMILAR TO A PORN STAR. IT ONLY SPEAKS WHILE HAVING ITS "MEAL", AND IT SPEAKS FOR THE PURPOSE OF INCITING THE MALE HUMAN TO EJACULATE INSIDE OF IT. IT DOES NOT RESPOND TO QUESTIONS OR DEMANDS, AND ONLY REPEATS ITS "BREED-BEGGING" OVER AND OVER

FUNGAL ENTITIES ARE A CO-DEPENDENT ORGANISM SEPARATE FROM SCP-51678G.

FUNGAL ENTITIES, HEREAFTER REFERRED TO AS "FUNGI", ARE PRODUCED INSIDE OF SCP-51678G'S INTERNAL ORGAN STRUCTURES. UPON SENSING A "MEAL", SCP-51678G BREATHES OUT THESE FUNGI SIMILARLY TO HOW HUMAN BEINGS EXHALE CARBON DIOXIDE. THESE FUNGI ARE MICROSCOPIC, EXISTING ON A BACTERIAL SCALE.

FUNGI, ONCE INSIDE A HOST'S BODY, BEGIN TO SPREAD THROUGH THE MUSCULAR SYSTEM THROUGH THE BLOOD STREAM. FUNGI ACTIVATE LONG-DEAD GENES AND CREATE IN THEIR HOST A SORT OF "BREEDING RUT", TURNING THEM TEMPORARILY INSANE WITH DESIRE FOR THE OPPOSITE SEX. ONCE THE BREEDING RUT IS ACTIVATED, THE FUNGI CONVERTS THE MUSCULAR BIOMASS OF THE HOST INTO STEM CELLS AND GROWS THE TESTES WITH THEM. THIS PROCESS LEADS TO DEATH BY ASPHYXIATION DUE TO LACK OF DIAPHRAGM MUSCULATURE.

A FUNGI INFECTION CAN BE REVERSED WITH STANDARD ANTIBIOTICS UNLESS THE PATIENT HAS BEEN INFECTED FOR MORE THAN A DAY. IF THE INFECTION HAS LASTED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS, IT WILL LIKELY BE FATAL UNLESS THE PATIENT UNDERGOES REMOVAL SURGERY. THE PROCEDURE IS BOTH COMPLEX AND LENGTHY, INVOLVING AND THE REMOVAL OF THE RENDERING THE PATIENT AND INFERTILE. HOWEVER, SURVIVAL RATES FOR THE SURGERY ARE MORE THAN 80%, INCLUDING DR. AND DR.

DESPITE SCP-51678G ONLY TAKING A FEMALE GUISE, FUNGI AFFECT BOTH SEXES. THE FUNGI'S EFFECT ON THE TESTES DOES NOT VISIBLY CHANGE A FEMALE SUBJECT IN ANY WAY. HOWEVER, THE "BREEDING RUT™ EFFECT STILL TAKES PLACE. THIS SUGGESTS THAT SCP-51678G MAY NOT PRODUCE FUNGI SOLELY TO INCREASE THE NUMBER OF "MEALS" IT GETS.

DUE TO INCIDENT DATA ON SCP-51678G HAS BEEN LEAKED TO THE PUBLIC. WHILE THE PSY-OPS DEPARTMENT SUCCESSFULLY HID THE EXISTENCE OF SCP-51678G, THE CORPORATION HAS SHOWN GREAT INTEREST IN PURCHASING SOME OF SCP-51678G'S FUNGI TO USE AS THE BASIS FOR A PHARMACEUTICAL DRUG.
